name: Organisational Knowledge Currency
description: Knowledge base and lessons-learned content stays reviewed and current, capability maturity/roadmap artefacts are refreshed as lessons accumulate, and traceability/user documentation is updated when what it describes changes.

conditions.statement: Knowledge Base Articles and Lessons Learned Reports are reviewed for continued accuracy on a defined cadence, not left indefinitely from their original authoring date.
A Capability Maturity Assessment or Capability Evolution Roadmap is refreshed following each major Lessons Learned Report.
A Traceability Matrix or piece of User/Technical Documentation is updated whenever the artefacts it traces or describes change materially, not left to drift.
